description: Register observations from static analysis of the Anbernic stock loader and U-Boot; applied to registers/canonical/hardware.json by tools/apply_firmware_registers.py and tools/build_dataset.py. Nothing here is hardware-validated.

new_blocks.dependencies: Bring-up order observed in the stock loader: CMU_DDRPLL enable cleared, CMU_DEVCLKEN0 DDRCH0/DMAC gated, CMU_DEVRST0 DDR/DMAC reset pulsed, clocks re-enabled, DDR PLL reprogrammed, then this block. Never write from a running OS.

new_blocks.notes: Block absent from the ATM7039-labelled header and all public RG35XX device trees. Base, offsets and operation order come from static analysis of the Anbernic stock loader; 128 of 129 accesses across both DRAM blocks match the public DesignWare uPCTL layout, which supports but does not prove that IP identity. Field meanings, widths and reset values are unknown on ATM7039S.

new_blocks.dependencies: Bring-up order observed in the stock loader: CMU_DDRPLL enable cleared, CMU_DEVCLKEN0 DDRCH0/DMAC gated, CMU_DEVRST0 DDR/DMAC reset pulsed, clocks re-enabled, DDR PLL reprogrammed, then this block. Never write from a running OS.

Base, offsets and operation order come from static analysis of the Anbernic stock loader; 128 of 129 accesses across both DRAM blocks match the public DesignWare PUBL layout, which supports but does not prove that IP identity. Field meanings, widths and reset values are unknown on ATM7039S.
